bib.title: Big Self-Supervised Models are Strong Semi-Supervised Learners
bib.venue: 34th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2020)

question: Can unsupervised pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, with big networks and a final distillation on unlabeled data, be a strong semi-supervised learner on ImageNet with 1% or 10% of labels?
hypothesis: The fewer the labels, the more task-agnostic use of unlabeled data benefits from a bigger network, and the big model's task-specific knowledge can be distilled into a smaller one with little loss.
contributions: For semi-supervised learning via task-agnostic use of unlabeled data, the fewer the labels, the more it is possible to benefit from a bigger model.
Big models matter for general representations, but task-specific use of unlabeled data (distillation) transfers performance into a smaller network.
A deeper projection head, fine-tuned from a middle layer, improves linear evaluation and semi-supervised fine-tuning.
A three-step recipe (SimCLRv2 pretrain, fine-tune, distill) sets a new state of the art on ImageNet semi-supervised learning.

method.summary: SimCLRv2 improves SimCLR with bigger ResNets (up to ResNet-152 3x+SK), a 3-layer projection head fine-tuned from its first layer, and a MoCo-style memory. The pretrained network is fine-tuned on 1% or 10% of ImageNet labels, then used as a teacher to distil into a student (same or smaller) on unlabeled images with no real labels.
method.task: semi-supervised ImageNet image classification (self-supervised contrastive pretraining, fine-tuning, distillation)

datasets.name: ImageNet ILSVRC-2012
datasets.split: randomly sub-sampled 1% or 10% labeled subsets (TFDS imagenet2012_subset); all images unlabeled for pretraining and distillation
datasets.preprocessing: Pretraining: random crop, color distortion, Gaussian blur. Fine-tuning and distillation: random crop and horizontal flip only.

datasets.name: CIFAR-10
datasets.preprocessing: Broader color operators and Sobel filtering added to SimCLR augmentations for pretraining

models.name: SimCLRv2 ResNet family (depth 50/101/152, width 1x/2x, with/without SK)
models.architecture: ResNet (ResNet-D variant when SK is used) with selective kernels (SK); MLP projection head, 3 layers
models.layers: 50, 101 or 152; projection head 3 layers (2 to 4 explored)

other.projection_head_width: middle layers set to the width of the head's input, so it scales with the width multiplier

other.note: trained with all labels for 90 epochs; for 1%/10% labels AutoAugment and label smoothing used (Fig 4)

training.objective: Pretraining: NT-Xent contrastive loss (Eq 1) with cosine similarity and temperature tau. Fine-tuning: supervised cross-entropy. Distillation: cross-entropy between teacher and student softmax with temperature (Eq 2), no real labels; optional weighted mix with labeled loss (Eq 3).
training.optimizer: LARS, momentum 0.9, for pretraining, fine-tuning and distillation
training.lr: pretraining max 6.4 (= 0.1 x sqrt(BatchSize)); fine-tuning 0.16 (= 0.005 x sqrt(BatchSize)) for standard ResNets and 0.064 (= 0.002 x sqrt(BatchSize)) for larger variants; distillation same schedule as pretraining
training.lr_schedule: pretraining: linear warmup then cosine decay; fine-tuning: no warmup
training.warmup: pretraining: linear increase over the first 5% of epochs; fine-tuning: none
training.batch_size: pretraining 4096 (global batch norm); fine-tuning 1024; distillation same as pretraining
training.epochs: pretraining 800; fine-tuning 60 (1% labels), 30 (10% labels and 100% labels); distillation 400
training.weight_decay: pretraining 1e-4; fine-tuning none; distillation same as pretraining
training.regularisation: Distillation: no strong augmentation or extra regularisation; fine-tuning: only crop and flip
training.seeds: CIFAR-10 fine-tuning 5 seeds; ImageNet not stated

other.distillation_temperature: 0.1 for self-distillation, 1.0 for large-to-small (Sec 3.1); Appendix F: 0.1 when teacher is a fine-tuned model, otherwise 1.0
other.finetune_from_layer: first layer of projection head for 1%/10% labels; input of projection head for 100% labels
other.cifar10_pretraining: 800 epochs, batch 512, temperature 0.2, no 3-layer head and no EMA network; ResNet depths 18/34/50/101/152/200 with SK, width 1x

metrics.name: Top-1 accuracy
metrics.definition: ImageNet validation top-1 accuracy after fine-tuning on 1%/10%/100% labels, or after training a linear classifier on frozen ResNet output (linear eval), or after distillation

eval.protocol: Single reported numbers per configuration; no seeds or confidence intervals stated for ImageNet. Linear eval uses the projection head input. Parameter counts cover the ResNet up to final average pooling.

availability.weights: pretrained checkpoints at the same repository
availability.data: ImageNet; subsets listed in TensorFlow Datasets imagenet2012_subset

limits: Authors recognise ImageNet is a well-curated dataset and may not reflect real-world semi-supervised applications.
Why bigger models generalise better from few labels is only conjectured (more general features); authors say further work is needed.
Gains from bigger models may reflect a ceiling effect (Appendix A).
Width benefits appear to plateau: ResNet-152 (3x+SK) is only marginally better than (2x+SK) despite almost double parameters.
No seeds, variance or confidence intervals for ImageNet results; compute and wall-clock not stated.
Distillation uses only random crop and flip, no strong augmentation or consistency losses, which authors suggest could be improved.
Vision only; the NLP pretrain-then-fine-tune analogy is asserted, not tested.

terms.definition: Self-supervised pretraining where images are used without class labels so representations are not tailored to a specific classification task.
Using unlabeled data with a fine-tuned teacher's imputed labels (self-training/distillation) for the target task.
A non-linear MLP g(.) after the ResNet encoder in SimCLR; SimCLRv2 makes it deeper and fine-tunes from a middle layer instead of discarding it.
Distillation where the student has the same architecture as the teacher (excluding projection head).
